reuse.why: Reuses EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER and folds the copied category queries into getEditableCategories, but writes its own FIXED_TAG regex instead of the tree's extractTagsFromText from shared/tags, which already defines how tags are parsed from notes (escaping with ##, delimiters).

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the category query; the only new repetition is copyPreviousMonth applying the fixed-group check itself, following the tree's existing split between the SQL filter and copyPreviousMonth's row checks.

placement.why: The fixed-group lookup sits in budget/actions.ts next to EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER and hasSavedTemplates, where the tree keeps the month-wide selection rules.

scope.why: Only the month-wide selection, the budget-row query column and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: One function decides which groups are fixed and one function supplies categories to five actions, though the selection rule is still split across an SQL fragment, a JS filter and copyPreviousMonth's own checks, and the ad-hoc tag regex can drift from the app's tag semantics.

bypasses_abstraction.where: FIXED_TAG regex in budget/actions.ts re-implements tag detection instead of using extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

disguised_duplication.where: FIXED_TAG /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ is a reshaped version of the tag parsing in shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText, with different delimiter rules.

one_place.where: getFixedGroupIds in budget/actions.ts is the single definition of a #fixed group, used by getEditableCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) and by copyPreviousMonth.
